Presolicitation Notice





PRESOLICITATION NOTICE MODIFICATION_1

Request for Architectural and Engineer (A/E) 330 submission
Solicitation:  

Relocate Cath Lab to Fourth Floor Building 1, Project No. 657A5-26-104


The purpose of this modification is to:
Increase page limitation of SF330s. 65 pages are allowed. Title pages, tables of contents, and any required attachments, if applicable, are excluded from the page count limitation.

Extend SF330 submission due date until 5/26/26 at 2:00 pm CT. 

Change the NAICS Code of this procurement from 541310 Architectural Services to 541330 Engineering Services, with the small business size standard of $25.5 Million.

Allow any company that submitted an SF330 prior to the publishing of this modification, the opportunity revise and resubmit their SF 330 by the new submission deadline, if desired.
